name: Oath of Conquest
summary: Tyrants of the battlefield who rule through fear.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.short: Oath spells that are always prepared for free.
features.summary: You always have your oath spells prepared once you reach the listed paladin levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence
features.summary: As an action, each creature of your choice within 30 ft. makes a WIS save or is frightened of you for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
features.summary: When you make an attack roll, you can use Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to it, after seeing the roll.

features.name: Aura of Conquest
features.short: Frightened enemies near you can't move and take psychic damage.
features.summary: A creature frightened of you has speed 0 while within 10 ft. of you and takes psychic damage equal to half your paladin level when it starts its turn there. The range becomes 30 ft. at 18th level.

features.name: Scornful Rebuke
features.short: Creatures that hit you take psychic damage equal to CHA.
features.summary: Whenever a creature hits you with an attack, it takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), if you aren't incapacitated.

features.name: Invincible Conqueror
features.short: Resist all damage, extra attack and crits on 19-20.
features.summary: As an action, for 1 minute you have resistance to all damage, can make an extra attack as part of the Attack action, and score critical hits on 19 or 20. Once per long rest.
